hypotheses.M0_all_family_panels_are_balanced: Every family/split contains forty examples in each edit orientation.
hypotheses.M1_coherent_families_have_short_terminal: At least four of five families have output-conditioned median joint k90 at most three on both splits.
hypotheses.M2_family_program_length_replicates: Every family's median k90 differs by at most one head between the two splits.
hypotheses.M3_weight_rank1_preserves_family_head_or: At least four families have rank1-versus-complete median head-effect correlation at least 0.7 and winner agreement at least 0.5 on both splits.
hypotheses.M4_one_static_head_dominates_each_family: At least four families have a split-0 aggregate head that remains the per-example rank-1 winner at least half the time on split 1.
hypotheses.M5_routing_only_selector_is_family_usefu: At least four families retain at least 70% of oracle positive effect under routing-only per-example selection on both splits.
hypotheses.M6_coherent_families_are_shorter_than_he: The median k90 over family-by-split cells is at most three, compared with the previously frozen heterogeneous-control median of five.
